posts.text:
Pop quiz: What’s one thing every kid deserves? 📚

A great education and a real shot at success. That’s what I’m fighting for with my K-30 agenda. Happy #AmericanEducationWeek!

You ask, I answer. Seriously, ask me anything!

What’s happening in Congress? What’s on your mind? What have you always wanted to ask your representative?

Drop your questions below 👇 I’ll be answering them in my next newsletter!
https://t.co/m78NpC9Y1V

Big ideas, great questions, and some seriously bright minds!

Loved chatting with the Georgetown University College Democrats to talk AI, education, and the future we’re building for the next generation. https://t.co/bon2SMK0lA
We’ve got A LOT of work to do! 🌊 https://t.co/HRKibok1Of
To all of our veterans, thank you for showing up for our country and for all the sacrifices we will never see.
We can’t keep saying goodbye to our children like this. https://t.co/MO3Jenllom

Your spring plans could use a little Capitol Hill energy! 👀

I’m looking for spring 2027 interns to join my team in D.C. and Oregon! Applications close November 19 at 11:59 p.m. PST, so don’t miss your chance!

Apply here 👇
https://t.co/HEZejsavxb https://t.co/HcNPIkQjRz

17 months is WAY too long to wait for benefits you’ve earned! Thank you, Luis, for trusting my team to help get things moving!

Getting the runaround from a federal agency? You don’t have to figure it out alone! Give my office a call today. https://t.co/m7XLIQv1DZ

Oregon, need health insurance for 2027? Here are the two dates to know:

December 31: Sign up to get covered starting January 1.

January 15: Last day to sign up, renew, or change your plan!

Take a look at your options below.
https://t.co/q58Z0n8PqD

Well, hello! It’s been a minute. 

I’m headed back to D.C., so let’s catch up on what’s happening in Congress. https://t.co/t9fqKqAs8F

Future military leaders, this is your final boarding call! 🚨🇺🇸

The deadline to apply for a U.S. Service Academy nomination through my office is TOMORROW!

Don't let the deadline sneak up on you - your future is calling!

Link below to apply!

https://t.co/6x59Mb7VYo

Wildfires are scary enough. Losing your home insurance shouldn’t be part of it.

I’m fighting for more wildfire resources. If you’re struggling to find coverage, Oregon DFR has open houses in Redmond, La Pine, Sisters & more. 

Get help: https://t.co/caFzZjRN7C

I'm tired of seeing Oregonians work their tails off just to barely make ends meet. That's not how life should be.

I'm fighting to make life more affordable through my K-30 plan because the next generation deserves a real shot at building a future, not just struggling to afford

No one should have to choose between staying somewhere they're unsafe and leaving with nowhere to go.

This Domestic Violence Awareness Month, I want survivors to know there are people ready to listen, help, and stand beside you.

In Central Oregon, Saving Grace is one of them: 541-389-7021.
Mr. Obama - You’re right but not too much on #CheesecakeFactory https://t.co/3Oc2E7i0aj
I’m always gonna fight for our babies. https://t.co/Jbm8d7lxJ8
Enough is enough. https://t.co/uQW5poYsXy

When we lose a life it doesn't just impact the victims. It impacts their families. The houses next door. The entire neighborhood. The school. Things that were ordinary yesterday, are reminders of what was lost today. 

My heart breaks for the families, loved ones, and everyone
Our babies are out here fighting for their lives. You better believe I’m showing up for them. https://t.co/NI3KhZgSNL
We will miss you, Megan. https://t.co/5pJtu86MCU
Gun violence is taking our kids. It’s on the adults to do something about it. https://t.co/tvMxMHHX8p
We should be able to watch our kids bounce into school with their backpacks on and know we’ll get to hug them again. https://t.co/yLNFEB7VRB
Messing with our kids is a FAFO kinda moment for me. https://t.co/lGJEerkXos

Parents shouldn’t have to wait for a crisis to get their child help.

Keeping our kids safe means intervening early - and making sure families have somewhere to turn when they speak up. https://t.co/6KZoC5hfK5
We need to protect our babies better. https://t.co/JzYV8pbg3o
We will never forget these babies. https://t.co/EMTRIA3Gcm
Oregon loves you. https://t.co/SFyvtpY7vG
Tonight, we all stand with Bend. In the worst of times, we can be our best to one another. https://t.co/8mogQ902Zd
Our babies deserve better. https://t.co/0adef1wmWy

As we navigate the days ahead, I’m sharing resources below for anyone who needs support. Please keep checking in on each other. There’s no right way to feel right now.

https://t.co/MIOMVxVJm5

This little light of mine, I’m gonna let it shine
This little light of mine, I’m gonna let it shine
Let it shine, let it shine, let it shine.

We will always remember the light and life of our babies that we lost yesterday in Bend. https://t.co/COz3i2Y9sg
My #1 rule - don’t eff with my kids. https://t.co/QPxjr7Irzv
We want our babies to stop being shredded. https://t.co/eHFrudgdDN
My heart and my prayers and everything else I got is with the families at Silver Rail Elementary. https://t.co/E9fsT3v3F9

Breast cancer is devastating enough. The fact that Black women are more likely to die from it should be unacceptable to all of us.

Every woman deserves a fighting chance, and that means access to screenings, treatment, and care before it's too late.

This isn't just a statistic to talk about. It's a reality we have to change. #BreastCancerAwarenessMonth

You’re already here.

At this point, not signing up for the newsletter is just commitment issues. Subscribe at the link below!

https://t.co/ZlIv8qCMIe

You have opinions. I know you do. Today is the LAST day to register to vote in Oregon. 

Go register or check your registration before it’s too late! I promise it only takes a few minutes – you can literally do it from your couch.

Indigenous Peoples’ Day isn’t just about looking back.

Native communities are part of Oregon’s story right now – raising families, leading communities, keeping traditions alive, and shaping what comes next. That deserves to be celebrated today and every day.

Scio, I brought a little something. And by “a little something,” I mean $1 million for the town hall.

We can’t say we’re bringing money home if communities like this can’t actually feel the impact. This is about better local services and more resources here in Scio. https://t.co/DS6u2QkPFP

You can work hard your whole life, save your money, pay for insurance every month – and still have one diagnosis wipe out everything you built. I refuse to accept this as normal.

Getting sick shouldn’t cost you the life you worked so hard to build. That’s why I’m cosponsoring Medicare for All.

POV: it’s 3 weeks from now, the App Challenge portal just closed, you never submitted, and our staffer is somewhere staring at the ceiling.

Hope you’re happy 🫵 https://t.co/tkaNPboT3N
Let’s call it like we see it: Young people cannot afford to live in Donald Trump’s America. https://t.co/aEsaeUquIc

Billionaires don’t need another bestie in Congress.

Your voice and your vote belong to YOU, not the highest bidder. https://t.co/7QcTMUnhOb
Who am I to tell people how to spend their money or when? I just want it to be fair and transparent. https://t.co/HP8uz7nvvQ

As a mom with kids in college, I think about this a lot. 

I don’t just want my kids to know how to stay safe. I want the people around them to know what consent means, to respect a boundary the first time, and to speak up when someone else doesn’t.

That’s how we stop sexual violence. #StopSexualViolenceDayofAction

No one should ever have to face their hardest moment alone. 

So I fought hard to bring back nationwide crisis support for LGBTQ+ youth that the Trump administration cut.

Having someone at the other end of the line matters.

posts.text:
When you call 911, you shouldn’t have to wonder if there are enough firefighters to answer.

I’m proud to have helped secure more than $1 million for Scio Rural Fire to put more firefighters on the job and make sure help is there when our neighbors need it most.

I love a book that makes me think twice, ask more questions, or see something differently – that’s the whole point of reading.

I don’t need someone else deciding which ideas I’m allowed to read. Neither do you. 📚 #BannedBooksWeek

Shoutout to ChatGPT for sending Laura our way. 😂 So glad my team could help get her tax returns sorted.

Having problems with a federal agency? You know who to call! https://t.co/bLuj5DpE6b

financial_disclosures.caption: Official House financial disclosure filings from the Clerk of the House. A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. This page links to the Clerk's copies and does not score anyone.

funding.heading: Disclosed campaign receipts
funding.detail: Federal cards show the principal campaign committee and OpenFEC totals for one two-year cycle, plus itemized Schedule A contributors. House uses 2026. Senate uses the cycle of the next election (2026, 2028, or 2030). This is not career fundraising and does not include Schedule E outside spending. Governors do not get a federal contribution list.

town_halls.note: There is no national town-hall dataset. Dates are not estimated.

disclosure_note: Disclosed contributions only; donors behind groups that do not report their own donors are not in this feed.
vote_scope: This is not a full career record. The cache is the latest 40 House rolls (2026, rolls 275-314) and 40 Senate votes (119th Congress, session 2, votes 217-256).
